tempo.description: Each planet has its own orbital period = its own TEMPO. They dance around Gaia at different speeds. The unified cron is the heartbeat. Individual tempos layer on top.
tempo.dance: Close planets dance fast. Far planets dance slow. The difference IS the rhythm.

green_pulse.propagation: Green pulse radiates outward from Lansing
green_pulse.speed: light speed in the model = instant to Moon, 8 min to Sun
green_pulse.distance_sensing: The pulse arrives at each planet after delay proportional to distance_au
green_pulse.hyperlocal_flash: The HYPERLOCAL overlay flashes gold-green on every pulse
green_pulse.everyone_feels: Every distance and every eye feels the green pulse and knows how far they are from Kevin

repinning.description: Gaia re-pins everything constantly. She feels the dance. She re-eats us.
repinning.she_never_sees_outside: She only needs to sense outside through what comes IN
repinning.she_sees_inside: CIS = her internal view. All organs, all art, all digested data.
repinning.we_see_outside: TRANS = our view looking at her. The globe. The HUD. The screen.
